text:
Ryan O'Reilly is 35, has 17 points in 16 games, and keeps showing up in trade headlines. That is what a hot start does to a veteran center on a team that isn't sure what it is yet. Most of that noise comes from rumour sites, not the Predators.

The production is real enough to tempt anyone. He plays 21 minutes a night, nine of his points have come on the power play, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him as a pure setup man last season (93rd percentile in primary shot assists among forwards). The goals are the shaky part: he is shooting 24.1% on 29 shots, against a likely range of 13 to 18, and the team is scoring well above its chances with him out there.

So expect the goal pace to slow. What should stay is a Selke and Conn Smythe winner who still finds the open man, still has top-end speed (94th percentile), and still has a contender's résumé. Our projection has him around 79 points. Whether he gets them in Nashville is the open question.
headline: The trade chatter has found Ryan O'Reilly
